purpose: Decision contract for a durable external fame sidecar; this generation authorizes measurement only and cannot alter construction output.

identity_model.release_handling: Keep accepted GERS-to-QID mappings durable. For each Overture release, derive an attested membership/delta containing present, added, removed, and reassigned GERS IDs; do not rematch every surviving ID by default.
identity_model.reason: GERS IDs are intended to be stable, while measured bridge continuity determines the size of the exception path. QIDs key the independently refreshed Wikidata fame table.

required_evidence: Cross-release bridge continuity report for every Places bridge dataset shared by the two measured releases.
A deterministic candidate set with matcher version and source hashes.
At least 200 independently hand-checked candidate decisions, including every proposed automatic-accept rule.
False-accept examples and rejection reasons retained rather than deleted.
Measured broadcast bytes and resident join memory for the accepted mapping.
phase1_stop_line: A later v5 evidence generation may be proposed only after Phase 0 passes. This file does not authorize a projection join, prominence change, planet build, or promotion.
